scope: Two explicit source-observation extensions, separate from the original 77 metrics; no physiological inference or candidate authority.

OBS-VO2-REPORTED.query: 来源报告的 VO2max 记录：区分设备估计、来源报告值与气体分析实测，核对测量协议、适用人群及测量误差；不能由 HealthKit 字段确认生理真值或推断训练因果作用。
query_aliases: source reported VO2max cardiorespiratory fitness wearable estimation criterion measurement validity protocol uncertainty

OBS-CYCLE-RECORDS.query: 月经类别观测记录的测量与解释边界：原始类别不等于出血天数或周期数，缺少记录不能推断没有月经，不能据此确认周期阶段、排卵、避孕、诊断或个人训练处方。
query_aliases: menstrual flow recorded categories missing observations cycle phase ovulation inference limitations measurement protocol
